subject: Request: build-queue hold extension for POC due to integration backlog
messages:
From: Jared Long <jared.long@fiscotech.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fiscotech.com>
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Build queue hold — POC timeline slipping, request for extension

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from our side — our engineering team hit an unexpected queue backlog while wiring up the SAML connector and the new data adapter for the POC. The blocker is with our infra vendor (they're patching a dependency) and we've been told the earliest fix window is ~10 business days.

That pushes our demo and validation work out and means we'll exhaust the sandbox tokens before we can complete the end-to-end tests.

Can Redwood extend our trial/runway and add a small credit buffer so we don't lose the provisioning we've set up? We were hoping for:
- 2 extra weeks on the trial window
- A small top-up of 200k token credits to cover the demo + smoke tests

Happy to share logs if useful — attaching the latest error dump. Let me know if there's any info you need from our engineering lead.

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Long
Head of Platform
FiscoTech

Attachment: integration-error-log.txt
From: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Build queue hold — POC timeline slipping, request for extension

Thanks for the heads-up, Jared — sorry to hear about the infra vendor window. Appreciate the error dump, that's helpful.

Quick plan from my side:
- I'm going to loop in Ben (sales ops) to evaluate a short runway extension + credit top-up.
- Marissa from CS will prepare an onboarding hold checklist so nothing times out while you wait for the vendor patch.

Could you confirm two things so we can expedite approval:
1) Target new demo date (approx)
2) Any compliance sign-offs pending that could extend the timeline again (e.g., external audit window)

If you can reply with those, I'll prioritize this with Ben and get back within one business day.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0182

- Extend the trial window by 21 days
- Add a 250k token sandbox credit top-up (consumable only on the POC workspace)

Approval path: I have provisional manager approval for up to 200k. Anything above that requires a quick sign-off (we can get it same day if we document the blocker). If you accept the 250k ask, I'll drop a one-line approval request to finance and loop in legal for a short amendment.

Marissa — can you set the onboarding hold (disable auto-termination, preserve workspace config) so the customer doesn't have to reprovision?

Jared — can you confirm the new estimated demo date? If it's within 3 weeks, I can push it through as a standard top-up. If it's longer, we'll propose a staged approach.
